name: coordinator-transparent-routing
body: Routing is transparent. `apg node` / `apg edge` auto-detect a live session by a Unix socket under `apg/.trans/` and forward the mutation to it; when no session is running they fall back to today's direct path. The `apg_node` / `apg_edge` tool surface, the CLI arguments, and every agent prompt are unchanged — the agents cannot tell whether a coordinator is running. Acceptance: the same command works identically with and without a live session, and no tool/agent surface changes.
